WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    ($1::json->>'as_of')::date AS as_of,
    ($1::json->>'student_id')  AS student_id
),
hw_stats AS (
  SELECT
    h.student_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN h.status = 'missed' THEN 1 END)              AS missed_hw,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN h.submitted_at IS NOT NULL
               AND h.submitted_at::date > h.deadline THEN 1 END) AS late_hw,
    COUNT(h.id)                                                   AS total_hw
  FROM homework h
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE h.student_id = p.student_id
    AND h.deadline <= p.as_of
  GROUP BY h.student_id
),
login_stats AS (
  SELECT
    l.student_id,
    MAX(l.login_date)                                                    AS last_login_date,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN l.login_date >= p.as_of - 7   THEN 1 END)           AS last7_logins,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN l.login_date >= p.as_of - 28
               AND  l.login_date <  p.as_of - 7   THEN 1 END)           AS prev4wk_logins
  FROM login_events_n8n l
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE l.student_id = p.student_id
    AND l.login_date <= p.as_of
  GROUP BY l.student_id
),
msg_stats AS (
  SELECT
    m.student_id,
    MAX(m.message_date)      AS last_msg_date,
    BOOL_OR(m.to_mentor)     AS wrote_to_mentor
  FROM slack_messages_n8n m
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE m.student_id = p.student_id
    AND m.is_from_student = TRUE
    AND m.message_date <= p.as_of
  GROUP BY m.student_id
)
SELECT
  s.student_id,
  s.name,
  s.slack_id,
  s.course,
  s.mentor_id,
  s.status,
  p.as_of - ls.last_login_date    AS last_login_days_ago,
  ls.last7_logins                  AS last7_logins,
  ls.prev4wk_logins                AS prev4wk_logins,
  hw.missed_hw                     AS missed_hw,
  hw.late_hw                       AS late_hw,
  hw.total_hw                      AS total_hw,
  p.as_of - ms.last_msg_date       AS last_msg_days_ago,
  ms.wrote_to_mentor               AS wrote_to_mentor
FROM students_n8n s
CROSS JOIN params p
LEFT JOIN hw_stats    hw ON hw.student_id = s.student_id
LEFT JOIN login_stats ls ON ls.student_id = s.student_id
LEFT JOIN msg_stats   ms ON ms.student_id = s.student_id
WHERE s.student_id = p.student_id;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    ($1::json->>'as_of')::date  AS as_of,
    ($1::json->>'student_id')   AS student_id
),
hw_ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        h.student_id, 
        h.deadline, 
        h.submitted_at,
        CASE WHEN h.submitted_at::date <= h.deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS on_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.student_id ORDER BY h.deadline) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY h.student_id) AS total
    FROM homework h
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE h.submitted_at IS NOT NULL 
      AND h.student_id = p.student_id
      AND h.submitted_at::date <= p.as_of
      AND h.deadline <= p.as_of
),
hist AS (
    SELECT AVG(on_time::float) AS hist_rate
    FROM hw_ordered 
    WHERE rn <= FLOOR(total * 0.6)
),
recent AS (
    SELECT AVG(on_time::float) AS recent_rate
    FROM hw_ordered 
    WHERE rn > total - 3
)
SELECT
    h.hist_rate,
    r.recent_rate,
    h.hist_rate > 0.8                            AS cond_hist,
    r.recent_rate < 0.5                          AS cond_recent,
    CASE WHEN h.hist_rate > 0.8 AND r.recent_rate < 0.5
         THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
    END AS submission_timing_shift
FROM hist h, recent r;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    ($1::json->>'as_of')::date AS as_of,
    ($1::json->>'student_id')  AS student_id
)
SELECT
  s.student_id,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT ARRAY_AGG(m.text ORDER BY m.message_date DESC)
       FROM slack_messages_n8n m
      WHERE m.student_id      = s.student_id
        AND m.is_from_student = TRUE
        AND m.message_date   <= p.as_of),
    ARRAY[]::text[]
  ) AS recent_messages
FROM students_n8n s
CROSS JOIN params p
WHERE s.student_id::text = p.student_id;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO analysis_results
  (student_id, risk_score, risk_level, urgency,
   recommended_action, secondary_action, priority,
   student_state, primary_drivers, supporting_evidence,
   draft_message, mentor_summary, dashboard_label, analyzed_at)
VALUES (
  $1::json->>'student_id',
  ($1::json->>'risk_score')::integer,
  $1::json->>'risk_level',
  $1::json->>'urgency',
  $1::json->>'recommended_action',
  $1::json->>'secondary_action',
  $1::json->>'priority',
  $1::json->>'student_state',
  ($1::json->'primary_drivers')::jsonb,
  ($1::json->'supporting_evidence')::jsonb,
  $1::json->>'draft_message',
  $1::json->>'mentor_summary',
  $1::json->>'dashboard_label',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (student_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  risk_score          = EXCLUDED.risk_score,
  risk_level          = EXCLUDED.risk_level,
  urgency             = EXCLUDED.urgency,
  recommended_action  = EXCLUDED.recommended_action,
  secondary_action    = EXCLUDED.secondary_action,
  priority            = EXCLUDED.priority,
  student_state       = EXCLUDED.student_state,
  primary_drivers     = EXCLUDED.primary_drivers,
  supporting_evidence = EXCLUDED.supporting_evidence,
  draft_message       = EXCLUDED.draft_message,
  mentor_summary      = EXCLUDED.mentor_summary,
  dashboard_label     = EXCLUDED.dashboard_label,
  analyzed_at         = NOW();

WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    ($1::json->>'as_of')::date AS as_of,
    ($1::json->>'student_id')  AS student_id
),
hw AS (
  SELECT
    h.hw_id,
    h.module,
    h.title,
    h.deadline,
    h.submitted_at,
    h.status,
    h.grade,
    CASE WHEN h.submitted_at IS NOT NULL
         AND  h.submitted_at::date > h.deadline
         THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
    END AS was_late
  FROM homework h
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE h.student_id = p.student_id
    AND h.deadline <= p.as_of
    AND (h.submitted_at IS NULL OR h.submitted_at::date <= p.as_of)
)
SELECT hw_id, module, title, deadline, submitted_at, status, grade, was_late
FROM hw
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hw)
ORDER BY deadline ASC NULLS LAST;
